newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares set more new records.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares set more new records.

text.p: Share activity on the Estonian stock exchange maintained its upward trend on Wednesday, with trade and the index setting new highs.
Total trade on the official list set a new high of 74.5 million kroons and the Tallinn stock exchange index climbed by 2.49 percent to close at 188.05.
"Small investors still dominate trade but the room for further price rises is limited," said one trader.
Hansapank led the rally with a turnover of 18.1 million kroons and closed 10 kroons higher at 181 kroons.
Trading was also strong in Forekspank, with prices up seven kroons to finish at 142 on turnover of 15.9 million kroons.
Saving Bank traded 15.3 million kroons to finish at 86.50, five kroons higher, after it announced 1996 year profits of 64.8 million kroons.
"Their results were as expected and so the impact was low," said one trader.
Union Bank slipped 0.35 kroons on trade of 11.7 million kroons but Tallinna Pank gained ground to close at 71.45 kroons, up 3.95 kroons, with 9.8 million shares traded.
Over-the-counter trade was led again by the Rakvere meat plant on 5.7 million kroons and it closed down 0.15 at 14 kroons.
